description: List channel listings (a property's presence on a listing site such as Airbnb/Vrbo). OwnerRez API: GET /v2/listings. Returns { items, count, limit, offset, next_page_url }.

limit.description: Max items to return per page (default set by OwnerRez, typically 10).

offset.description: Number of items to skip (for paging; combine with limit).

params.description: Additional documented query-string filters to send verbatim (merged with the typed params above).

name: list_listings
title: List listings
